sentences: Quantum communication can outperform randomized classical communication dramatically on some problems with restricted inputs.
This project asks whether an exponential separation is possible for a total function, whose value is defined on every input pair.
The cited work also emphasizes efficient local computation by the communicating parties, so a protocol's message length is not its only resource.
Promise-problem separations do not by themselves answer the total-function question because their input restrictions may be essential.
Resolving this would clarify how broadly quantum communication advantages survive when both the task specification and the players' computations are constrained.
